priority.hint: Adjust the provider call order for each capability: the top provider is tried first, with automatic fallback on failure. For model-level priority, use the Models page.

defaults.defaultVoiceHint: Used when text_to_voice is called without a voice; query list_voices for options
defaults.referenceAudioHint: Takes precedence over the default voice (voice cloning, OpenAI-style protocols on the models chain only)
defaults.videoResolutionHint: e.g. 768P / 1080P (Hailuo) or 2K (MiniMax-H3); empty means model default

styles.hint: Style presets are used by the style parameter of generate_image / generate_video: a preset name appends its suffix, otherwise the raw text is appended.
styles.suffixPlaceholder: Style suffix (English description appended to the prompt)
